PendingRfcTerminalCascadeQueryV1.rule: cursor semantic body is pinned by queries/rfc-lifecycle.json GetPendingRfcTerminalCascade and binds resolved pending proposal identity/revision/scope fingerprint

RfcTerminalCascadePreviewQueryV1.rule: cursor is bound to exact proposal revision plus preview_fingerprint; changed scope or cross-domain impact authority invalidates continuation

body_fields.execution_review: RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1 emitted by a READY PreviewRfcTerminalCascade
body_fields.deliberate_action_proof: LLD-12 DeliberateActionProofV1 bound to proposal target, proposal_revision and execution_review.preview_fingerprint

ExecuteRfcTerminalCascadeRequestV1.rule: scope_fingerprint alone is not execution authority; writer recomputes current scope/provider summaries and requires exact reviewed preview fingerprint before proof consumption

body_fields.deliberate_action_proof: LLD-12 DeliberateActionProofV1 bound to action tickets.rfc.hard_delete, target_type=rfc, target_id=rfc_id, base_revision and eligibility_fingerprint

HardDeleteRfcRequestV1.rule: the proof is friction evidence only; HardDeleteRfc re-runs every local/provider guard and exact fingerprint before proof consumption

body_fields.uow: existing LLD-01 UnitOfWork owned by LLD-04 AcceptReconciliationProposal
body_fields.proposal: accepted LLD-04 RFC reconciliation proposal carrying exact proposal/revision/fingerprint/base-token bindings and accepted source-evidence delta
body_fields.command_context: in-process LLD-04 parent command context carrying outer command_id/hash and already-inserted parent command_receipt reference

RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1.rule: scope_fingerprint and terminal evidence are exact persisted proposal capture authority and never rebuilt from paged response members for replay/read

RfcTerminalCascadeDetailV1.rule: members are persisted immutable evidence ordered RFC before WFM then stored ordinal/member identity; continuation binds exact pending proposal

RfcHardDeleteProviderFreshnessV1.rule: token is LLD-03-derived from exact provider_id,rfc_id,status; it does not copy provider internals

fields.provider_freshness: exact closed map with keys source_evidence,tasks_objectives,inventory,communications and values RfcHardDeleteProviderFreshnessV1

rules: eligible iff blockers is empty and every provider status is CLEAR
blocker and provider ordering/derivation are owned by algorithms/rfc-hard-delete.json
preview fingerprint is returned even when blocked but deliberate proof may be issued only for an eligible current preview

fields.hard_delete_evidence_id: uuid equal to the committed ticket.rfc.hard_deleted audit_event_id and sole hard_delete_evidence result ref

rules: fixed-size committed response contains no live/current RFC revision claim after deletion
same command_id replay returns this exact stored result before owner-state reads and never reconstructs it from the deleted target
RFC archive transport and operation projection types are owned by types/rfc-archive.json.
RFC terminal-cascade preview response and cross-packet impact/execution-review types are owned by types/rfc-terminal-cascade-preview.json.
RFC hard-delete guard registry, provider token bytes, eligibility fingerprint and golden vector are owned by algorithms/rfc-hard-delete.json.
